message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed that the meeting is booked. Now I need to send the confirmation email to the partners.
The meeting is on Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00.
I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function to send the email to all four partners.
The body of the email should be professional and contain all the necessary information about the meeting.
I will then end the session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments:
